$comment: Code generated by go generate (internal/verbs/gen); DO NOT EDIT. Source: internal/verbs/registry.go.
description: Audit floors, proof coverage, waivers, decision SLAs, autonomy exceptions, and unlogged writes; write a reproducible report.

ledger.description: Ledger commit to read; default the ledger tip.

mark-merged.description: Move these stories (e.g. 38-50) that merged without proof, before or after the merge gate, to status:merged with a comment saying which; no report.

out.description: Also write the report to this file.

replay.description: Regenerate a report from the GitHub inputs snapshot at this ledger path (audit/<date>/…inputs.json); writes nothing.

since.description: Window start (YYYY-MM-DD UTC or RFC 3339); default the cursor of the newest audit report on the ledger, else 7 days back.

until.description: Window end and GitHub event cursor (RFC 3339, exclusive); default now. With --since and --ledger it regenerates a report.

title: audit
